title: Post-rainfall low oxygen pattern
text: River Zone 3 had dissolved oxygen below the project review band in two post-rainfall samples (4.2 and 4.8 mg/L). Treat this as a pattern to verify, not a contamination diagnosis.

title: Turbidity spike after rainfall
text: Turbidity reached 15.0 and 18.4 NTU in the same River Zone 3 sampling window. Compare with upstream readings and collect a duplicate sample.

title: Upstream reference remained in range
text: River Zone 2 remained inside the project review bands on the nearest comparable date, making it a useful reference for Zone 3 follow-up.

title: Calibration metadata changes confidence
text: An unusual reading without a calibration timestamp should remain local until a duplicate or second instrument confirms it.

title: Conflict fixture: Zone 3 baseline
text: The shared team record says the Zone 3 baseline was last reviewed on 12 August. This device has a local correction saying the review happened on 14 August; choose which version to keep.
